note: Every mistake Pushpam has flagged, as checks the QA runs on every video. Add new ones with qa_learn.py add. Never delete; set active=false to retire.

lessons.look_for: a character standing or walking ON a wall, roof, table, car or other object instead of the floor/road
lessons.from: GTA 6 v2 1:23, 3:21, 3:23, 9:36 (22 Nov); checklist 1, 3, 6; DumDown Avengers Mistakes (Pushpam 22 Nov): characters hovering over objects
lessons.fix: put feet on the floor plane; walk to the door along the ground

lessons.look_for: a character sitting on air, or seated without a chair/bed under them
lessons.from: checklist 2; DumDown Avengers Mistakes (Pushpam 22 Nov): characters not sitting properly on chairs
lessons.fix: add the seat, align hips to it

lessons.look_for: props, objects, papers, glasses, signs floating in the air instead of resting on a table/surface or held in a hand
lessons.fix: seat the object on the table top with a contact shadow, or put it in the hand

lessons.look_for: a road, street or vehicles drawn at the wrong angle for the camera (road should run sideways across the frame, or a car facing the wrong way)
lessons.fix: turn the road to run left-right across the frame, vehicles in side view on it

lessons.look_for: wrong real-world size: a car smaller than a person, people bigger than houses, giant cups, tiny background people
lessons.fix: scale to real sizes (car ~4.5 m, person ~1.75 m, door ~2 m)

lessons.look_for: characters overlapping each other or clipping through furniture, doors, desks, chairs or props
lessons.fix: separate on depth; move the prop; character in front of/behind furniture properly

lessons.look_for: a map, image or graphic spilling outside its TV/screen/frame instead of being masked inside it
lessons.fix: clip the content to the screen rectangle (mask)

lessons.look_for: a scene that does not show the action the story needs (e.g. hospital scene without the patient sitting on a bed, no injection, generic background instead)
lessons.fix: build the specific scene the VO describes, with the action shown

lessons.look_for: text, captions, titles or cards covering a character's face or body, cut off at the frame edge, or placed over other text
lessons.fix: move text to empty space inside the safe area

lessons.look_for: plain, empty, flat or low-detail background, blocky textures
lessons.fix: add set detail, texture, props, light

lessons.look_for: very dark frame where the subject is hard to see, or a black/blank frame
lessons.fix: lift key light / re-render the missing shot

lessons.look_for: broken bodies: missing or extra limbs, distorted faces, hair over the eyes, glasses or mustache in the wrong place
lessons.fix: fix the rig / face add-on anchor

lessons.look_for: the previous scene still showing after a cut, or the camera past the edge of the background (black strip)
lessons.fix: hard cut cleanly; keep camera inside the plate

lessons.look_for: a wrong or unofficial map of India, or wrong spelling/dates/names on screen
lessons.fix: use the official map; fix the text

lessons.look_for: a vehicle passing through a building, bridge or arch, or wheels not on the ground
lessons.fix: route the vehicle around; ground the wheels

lessons.look_for: the same background or scene reused in different parts of the video
lessons.from: GTA 6 v2 5:56 'the ocean looks same' (22 Nov); checklist 25, 67
lessons.fix: build a new set for the new place

lessons.look_for: voice-over cut off before the sentence ends (hard stop in speech)
lessons.fix: extend the shot or trim at a pause; never cut VO mid-sentence

lessons.look_for: a character's head, face or body cut off by the black bars / letterbox layout or the frame edge (bad framing)
lessons.fix: reframe: keep heads and hands inside the picture area; use taste + impeccable for framing

lessons.look_for: voice glitching: crackle, warble, pitch jumps, robotic artefacts or clipped words in the voice
lessons.fix: re-generate the glitched line; run voice_qa.py on the dry VO

lessons.look_for: a graphic box, card or overlay glitching: flicker, jump, pop, wrong frame for a moment
lessons.fix: fix the overlay's keyframes / z-order; ease in and out

lessons.look_for: rough, jarring cuts between gags and scenes (no transition, mid-motion jump, audio jump)
lessons.fix: cut on action or a quick whip/match cut; crossfade audio over the cut
